NAME: DMA controller verification plan
details: Source: GARUDA-DMA-SPEC-001, section 2 (requirements), section 10 (assertions) and section 11 (verification plan), written with the specification. Moved into vPlanner form on 2026-10-04; section 4 holds what the 2026-10-04 flow run added.

NAME: Requirements
details: From section 2 of the specification; planned tests from section 11.

NAME: R-1 Six independent channels one peripheral each.
details: Six independent channels, one peripheral each.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0008

NAME: t_dma_all_channels
details: Oracle: each channel transfers independently Coverage goal: all 6
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing, re-run after CDC removal. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, check [R-1] [R-2] each of 6 channels x byte, half, word - 1 check, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-2 P2M M2P and M2M transfer modes.
details: P2M, M2P and M2M transfer modes.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_dma_modes
details: Oracle: P2M, M2P, M2M each correct Coverage goal: 3 modes × 3 sizes
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing, re-run. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv runs all three modes ([N-7.1] [N-7.9] P2M, [R-2] M2P, [N-7.5] M2M) and sweeps the three sizes on every channel in M2M ([R-1] [R-2]); the full 3 modes x 3 sizes cross is not run - 6 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-3 No CDC logic on the configuration interface.
details: No CDC logic on the configuration interface.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0002

NAME: t_dma_no_cdc
details: Oracle: register access completes with no synchroniser latency
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks [R-3] back-to-back writes all land and a read directly behind a write returns the new value, and DMA-5 six writes give six one-hclk strobes - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: planned test
details: Oracle: dma_cdc_*.v absent from the file list
implementation_note: Status in the specification: review gate. Bench: Review, repeated 2026-10-04: rtl/dma/ holds dma_apb_slave.v, dma_arbiter.v, dma_chan.v, dma_engine.v, dma_top.v; there is no dma_cdc file and rtl/dma/filelist.f lists none.

NAME: R-4 Fixed-priority channel arbitration re-evaluated per beat.
details: Fixed-priority channel arbitration, re-evaluated per beat.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0004

NAME: t_dma_priority
details: Oracle: highest-priority requesting channel wins Coverage goal: all 15 channel pairs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: passing, re-run. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks tagged [R-4] (two channels requesting in the same cycle, all 15 pairs; ch0 armed while ch5 runs) and [N-7.11] ch0 over ch5 - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-5 Per-channel completion and error interrupts.
details: Per-channel completion and error interrupts.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_dma_interrupts
details: Oracle: complete and error reach the right CLIC IDs Coverage goal: all 12 IDs
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks tagged [R-5] (each channel raises only its own complete and error line), [N-7.4], [N-7.13] error IRQ - 4 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. All 12 lines to their CLIC IDs: sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c on tb_chip, RESULT: PASSED (error IDs are 8..13 after INT-2).

NAME: R-6 A channel shall report a consistent transfer count and completion ...
details: A channel shall report a consistent transfer count and completion status.
implementation_note: Source: Erratum D-1

NAME: t_dma_stat_consistent
details: Oracle: COMPLETE never with non-zero REMAINING
implementation_note: Status in the specification: D-1 regression guard. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks tagged [R-6] (55 back-to-back STAT reads through a transfer) and [N-6.2] DMA-4 - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-7 A hardware completion shall not be lost to a simultaneous ...
details: A hardware completion shall not be lost to a simultaneous software write.
implementation_note: Source: Erratum D-2

NAME: t_dma_write_collision
details: Oracle: software CR write in the completion cycle Coverage goal: collision at each of the last 3 beats
implementation_note: Status in the specification: D-2 regression guard. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks [R-7] hardware wins EN on the collision and the rest of the write lands, [N-7.19] [R-7], and the [N-11.2] CR-write sweep that hit the EN-clear cycle 4 times - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-8 An AHB ERROR shall abort only the affected channel.
details: An AHB ERROR shall abort only the affected channel.
implementation_note: Source: System

NAME: t_dma_error_isolated
details: Oracle: one channel errors, others unaffected Coverage goal: error on each channel
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks [R-8] [N-7.14] the other channel ran to completion and [R-5] [N-7.13] an error raises only that channel's line; an error is forced on every channel by the [R-9] sweep - 2 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_dma_errphase
details: Oracle: read vs write error distinguished Coverage goal: both phases
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks with ERRPHASE = read and ERRPHASE = write ([N-7.13], [N-6.3] [N-7.13], [R-9] [N-6.3]) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: R-9 The DMA shall have no access to Boot ROM or ISRAM.
details: The DMA shall have no access to Boot ROM or ISRAM.
implementation_note: Source: ADR-0005, 0015

NAME: t_dma_no_isram
details: Oracle: ISRAM and Boot ROM addresses give a clean ERROR Coverage goal: both regions
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks tagged [R-9] (SAR or DAR in ISRAM or boot ROM on every channel gives a clean ERROR; no AHB transfer ever addressed them) - 3 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: Planned tests not tied to one requirement
t_dma_req_ack
details: Oracle: one beat per request, across the pclk/hclk ratio
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv, checks tagged [N-7.10] (one beat and one ack per request), [N-7.8] ack is one pclk wide, [N-7.1] [N-7.9] P2M from a pclk-domain requester - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression. The bench runs the one pclk = hclk/2 ratio the chip uses.

NAME: t_dma_hw_sw_priority
details: Oracle: the [N-7.19] rule for every hardware-owned bit Coverage goal: all 5 bits
implementation_note: Status in the specification: new. Bench: PARTLY IMPLEMENTED - tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv sweeps the collision for EN, COMPLETE, ERROR and ERRPHASE ([N-7.19] checks and the two ICLR sweeps); the plan asks for all 5 hardware-owned bits and a fifth is not swept - 5 checks, all PASS in the 2026-10-04 regression.

NAME: t_dma_random
details: Oracle: constrained-random config vs. a reference model Coverage goal: all modes, sizes, channels
implementation_note: Status in the specification: extend. Bench: NOT IMPLEMENTED - no constrained-random configuration and no reference model in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv (it contains no random stimulus).

NAME: Assertions
details: From section 10 of the specification.

NAME: a_no_cdc_latency
details: and behaviourally: the register file responds within one hclk of the pclk edge
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-3] a read directly behind a write returns the new value).

NAME: a_remaining_complete_consistent
details: REMAINING and COMPLETE are always consistent (R-6, erratum D-1)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Named in a comment at rtl/dma/dma_chan.v:120. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-6] REMAINING tracks the bus through 55 STAT reads; [R-6] [N-7.3]).

NAME: a_active_implies_remaining
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-6] STAT reads through a transfer; CNT = 0: not ACTIVE).

NAME: a_hw_wins_en
details: hardware wins EN on a collision (R-7, erratum D-2)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-7] hardware wins EN on the collision; [N-11.2] sweep).

NAME: a_sw_write_lands
details: but the rest of the software write still lands
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-7] ... the rest of the write lands).

NAME: a_beat_atomic
details: a beat is never split between channels (N-7.11)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Named in a comment at rtl/dma/dma_engine.v:11. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-7.11] a beat is never split).

NAME: a_one_channel
details: exactly one channel active in the engine at a time
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-7.11] every read was followed by the same channel's write; [N-7.2]).

NAME: a_one_beat_per_req
details: one beat per request assertion (N-7.10)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-7.10] exactly one beat (one ack) per request assertion).

NAME: a_error_isolated
details: error aborts only the affected channel (R-8)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-8] [N-7.14]).

NAME: a_errphase
details: ERRPHASE is set correctly
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv (ERRPHASE = read and = write checks).

NAME: a_freeze_on_error
details: SAR/DAR/REMAINING freeze at the failure point (N-7.15)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-7.15] REMAINING, SAR and DAR frozen at the failure point).

NAME: a_no_isram
details: no ISRAM or Boot ROM access ever (R-9)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([R-9] [N-7.20] no AHB transfer ever addressed ISRAM or boot ROM).

NAME: a_mode3_rejected
details: MODE=3 is rejected (N-6.1)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-6.1] MODE = 3 write leaves MODE unchanged).

NAME: a_ch4_tied
details: channel 4 never requests (N-6.4)
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED, and out of date: [N-6.4] of the same specification now gives channel 4 to the SPI slave (wired at chip level, INT-1). Section 10 of the specification needs this property removed.

NAME: a_reset_disabled
details: all channels disabled at reset
implementation_note: assert property in specification section 10. NOT IMPLEMENTED as SVA. Checked procedurally in tb/dma/tb_dma_top.sv ([N-9.2] reset: all six channels disabled).

NAME: Added in the 2026-10-04 run
details: Checks added and defects found when the flow was run in order on 2026-10-04 (Docs/BUGS.md section 1h).

NAME: DMA-8 failed beat consumed the request
details: A failed beat marked the peripheral's request as taken; after firmware repaired the address and set EN again the channel sat ACTIVE and never eligible, a hang with no status bit set.
implementation_note: FIXED in rtl/dma/dma_chan.v. Covered by [N-7.7] [N-7.10] DMA-8: the still-pending request is served after the re-arm; PASS.

NAME: DMA-4 DMA-5 DMA-6 waivers now tested
details: The three waived items each have a directed test: ICLR in the cycle the flag sets, STAT read directly behind the arming write, six back-to-back APB writes giving exactly six strobes.
implementation_note: WAIVERS NOW TESTED: the ICLR sweeps, [N-6.2] DMA-4 and DMA-5 checks; all PASS.

NAME: INT-2 DMA error interrupts moved to IDs 8 to 13
details: CLIC ID 7 carried the machine timer's cause, so DMA error channel 0 was indistinguishable from a timer tick; ID 7 is now reserved and the DMA error lines are IDs 8..13.
implementation_note: FIXED, owner to confirm the map change. Covered by sw/chip/t_chip_integ.c (all six error interrupts); the specification text still shows the old IDs.

NAME: Bench checks added
details: The bench grew from 25 to 63 checks (sim/tb_dma/run.log: checks=63 FAIL=0): all channels and sizes, all 15 priority pairs, ISRAM and boot ROM on every channel, collision sweeps, EN cleared mid-transfer, CNT = 0 and 1.
